page.description: Raspberry Pi OS arm64 desktop image: size, architecture and the project's .sha256 file.
page.intro: The official Raspberry Pi OS for 64-bit boards, here the desktop image. These are Raspberry Pi images, not PC images: they are written to an SD card or USB stick and boot on Pi hardware.
pros: Official Raspberry Pi OS, tuned for the boards.
Desktop image with the Pi applications and tools.
Written to SD or USB and booted directly.
cons: Raspberry Pi only: not a PC or x86 image.
The desktop image is 1.4 GB compressed.
The version is the image date (2026-10-06).
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Raspberry Pi OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a card and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image: the arm64 desktop image, written to an SD card or USB stick with dd or an image writer. Writing replaces the whole device. This is a Raspberry Pi image, not a PC installer. The version is the image date (2026-10-06).
